Result: Show that there exists a natural number \( n \) such that the product of \( n+1 \) and \( \varepsilon \) is greater than 1. This can be proved by applying the Archimedean principle, which states that for any positive real number \( \varepsilon \) and any positive real number \( b \), there exists a natural number \( n \) such that \((n+1) \varepsilon > b\); here, \( b \) is taken to be 1.
